title: Merge the vault fee-switch upgrade to contracts/
decision: Merge branch t/ENG-77 (contracts/Vault.sol, contracts/FeeSwitch.sol) into main and schedule the upgrade transaction for the next maintenance window.
goal: Enable the protocol fee switch so the treasury starts accruing fees this month, as planned in strategy objective 2.
alternatives_rejected: Wait for the external audit report (three more weeks; the fee switch has been reviewed internally twice)
Deploy a fresh vault instead of upgrading (migrates every depositor; too disruptive)
expected_cost: 0.2 ETH gas for the upgrade transaction; 2 engineering hours
rollback_plan: Revert the merge commit on main if anything looks wrong after the upgrade.
why_now: The fee switch gates the treasury target for this quarter; every week of delay is lost revenue.
risk: A bug in the fee path could take fees from the wrong accounts until the next upgrade.
reversibility: The code change is reversible on main; the upgrade transaction is reversible by a second upgrade.
evidence: ticket ENG-77: Verification approve, overall 3.6, gates ci-green and verification-approved passed
